ABOUT DATABASE SEARCH

Within this broader Berlin engineering team, Database Search focuses on workload optimization: building core database-engine capabilities that help customer queries run faster by finding and processing data efficiently. The team works on indexing methods, index selection and maintenance, data pruning and skipping, and query optimization for selective SQL queries and other workloads. This work also contributes to Snowflake Optima, which automatically identifies optimization opportunities in customer workloads and seamlessly integrates them so queries get faster over time with minimal user input.




THE ROLE

As a Software Engineer, you’ll take on challenging problems inside the database engine, designing, implementing, and improving components across indexing, query optimization, and execution. You’ll drive work from investigation through tested implementation and collaborate with teammates to deliver robust solutions for demanding customer workloads.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Implement, test, and improve database-engine features across indexing, data pruning and skipping, query optimization, and execution.

 - Investigate performance and scalability bottlenecks using debugging, instrumentation, and measurement, then drive fixes through validation.

 - Write maintainable, reliable code and tests in C++ and/or Java.

 - Build and improve components in a highly parallel database engine, reasoning about how changes affect query execution end to end.

 - Work with teammates and partner engineering groups to refine designs, deliver changes, and share results.

 - Evaluate changes against customer workloads and system behavior, and measure their performance impact.

 - Proficiency in C++ and/or Java, with an interest in writing efficient, reliable systems software.

 - Foundational knowledge of data structures, algorithms, and software design.
